entry_loop.map_ops: each phase walks the tree by hand (the _Rb_tree lower_bound shape: node+0x28 key length, node+0x20 key data, memcmp, the 0x80000000 length-difference bound) from the root at ctx+0x10; on a miss it inserts via map_insert 0x5ef3c80 with the key string, then copy-assigns the value string into node+0x40 (SSO fast path, heap memcpy path, old-buffer dispose). The header keys instead go through map_find_insert 0x5ef40a0, which inserts via map_node_create 0x5ef3ed0 when absent and returns &node+0x40 (the value string).
entry_loop.portion: (double)value * 100.0 / (double)capacity, printed '%f' (6 decimals). A zero capacity gives inf (value > 0) or the x86 DIVSD indefinite QNaN (value == 0), printed '-nan'. The u64-to-double conversions use the sign-bit fixup (t = (v >> 1) | (v & 1), convert, double) at 0x5ef8cb5/0x5ef9140 (value) and 0x5ef8cd1/0x5ef9120 (capacity).

accessor.rule: returns *(table_base + i * 32) where table_base is the qword at 0x64ecd30; a RELATIVE relocation at 0x64ecd30 installs 0x6503c00 (the sibling table), and the next slot 0x64ecd38 installs 0x6503dc0 (the twin table)

initializer.method: calls the std::string-from-const-char* helper 0x5effdd0 once per entry with (rdi = table + i*0x20, rsi = literal) for both tables (twin table at 0x6503dc0 first, sibling table at 0x6503c00 second), then registers __cxa_atexit(destructor 0x5effea0, table, guard 0x64efa20) for each; the tables live in .bss, so their contents exist only through this initializer, not in the file

elapsed.rule: hi = snapshot+0x130, lo = snapshot+0x128; return hi - lo when lo < hi, else 0 (unsigned 64-bit)
elapsed.note: CORRECTED from open PR #3082, whose records.json and model say 'else hi'. The code is `mov $0x0,%edx; cmovae %rdx,%rax` (elapsed.txt 0x5eee59b/0x5eee5a0): rdx was just zeroed, so the else branch returns 0. #3082's test asserted elapsed_ns(30, 100) == 30 and elapsed_ns(50, 50) == 50; both are wrong per the binary and this packet's model returns 0 for both.

fmt_pct.rule: formats one double with the format string '%f' at 0x432165 via __vsnprintf_chk into a 0x148-byte stack buffer, then assigns the result into the std::string at rdi (SSO when the result is <= 15 bytes, heap via _M_create above that)
fmt_pct.second_arg: the caller passes the global at 0x64ed730 (file qword 0) as rsi; the helper never reads its incoming rsi on this path (its two rsi uses are fresh lea/mov for the length and the memcpy source)

to_string.rule: std::to_string(unsigned long long): the magnitude branches pick the digit count, _M_construct allocates that many NULs, and the pair loop fills the buffer from the end two digits at a time using the 100-pair decimal table ('00'..'99') copied in 16-byte chunks from .rodata to the stack (rsp+0xa0 in the inlined copies; the table bytes were verified to equal the '00'..'99' pairs exactly). The sibling inlines this same conversion three times per slot instead of calling it.

tree_destroy.rule: _Rb_tree::_M_erase: recurse on node+0x18 (right), dispose the two strings at node+0x40 and node+0x20, operator delete(node, 0x60), then tail-loop on node+0x10 (left). Node layout: header +0x00..+0x20, key string +0x20, value string +0x40.

map_find_insert.rule: std::map::operator[] for the map at rdi+0x08: lower_bound walk from the root at rdi+0x10 (node+0x28 key length, node+0x20 key data, memcmp, 0x80000000 bound); on a miss it creates the node via map_node_create 0x5ef3ed0 and returns &node+0x40 (the value string); on a hit it returns the found node's value string. The end sentinel is &map (rdi+0x08).

map_insert.rule: allocates a 0x60-byte node, copies the key string (pointed at by the caller's stack slot) into node+0x20, finds the insert position via map_insert_pos 0x5ef3ac0, rebalances via _Rb_tree_insert_and_rebalance, and increments the count at map+0x20 (rdi+0x28). On a duplicate key it frees the node and returns the existing node.

map_insert_pos.rule: the _Rb_tree::_M_get_insert_unique_pos walk: compares the key against node keys with string_compare 0x5eeb970 and _Rb_tree_increment/_Rb_tree_decrement, returning the parent and the side flag.

map_node_create.rule: allocates a 0x60-byte node, copies the key string into node+0x20 (heap via _M_create when longer than 15 bytes), finds the insert position via map_insert_pos 0x5ef3ac0, rebalances, and returns the node; used by map_find_insert on a miss.

string_compare.rule: std::string three-way compare (memcmp over the common prefix, then the length difference with the 0x80000000 bound); the shared comparator used by the map walks.

string_move_assign.rule: std::string move assignment: steals the source heap buffer when the source is heap-allocated, otherwise memcpys the SSO bytes; the old destination buffer is freed. Used for the header entries (capacity, secs_for_last_collection, secs_since_last_collection).

chain.rule: the sibling does NOT walk the handler chain the way the twin does: it calls the chain head's vtable slot +0x98 once, directly (main.txt 0x5ef848b..0x5ef8491, rdi = chain head), with no comparison against the walker 0x5d4d490 and no link walk. The return is the slot_now value used only for secs_since.
chain.secs_since: (slot_now - snapshot+0x130) as unsigned 64-bit (wraps), divided by 1,000,000 by the magic multiply (0x431bde82d7b634db, high word, shift 18); verified equal to unsigned // 1_000_000 on 200,010 values

cleanup.rule: on exception the fragment disposes the two stack strings (the key string at rsp+0x60 and the value string at rsp+0x80), checks the stack canary, and resumes unwinding via _Unwind_Resume; nine landing pads enter it at 0x5ef823c, 0x5ef8246, 0x5ef826b, 0x5ef8299, 0x5ef82a3, 0x5ef82c8, 0x5ef82d2, 0x5ef8301 and 0x5ef8326
